name: Taunting Strike
description: The cat lashes out with a quick, shallow bite, enraging its opponent.

name: Quick Claw
description: A blur of motion as the cat rakes its claws across its opponent's flank.

name: Strong Claw
description: The cat delivers a deliberate, powerful swipe, strengthened by coiled muscle.

name: Giga Stomp
description: After leaping high into the air, the cat slams into the ground, sending out a powerful shockwave.

name: Provoking Stare
description: The cat stands its ground, fixing the enemy with an unnerving, unflinching gaze that causes its opponent immense stress.

name: Tackle
description: Leaping into the air, the cat slams into the enemy with its entire body.

name: Shoulder Bash
description: The cat lowers its stance, driving a hard-as-granite shoulder into its foe.

name: Spiked Somersault
description: The cat rolls into a tight ball, extending claws and fur, rolling into enemies to deal serious damage

name: Sand Throw
description: A rapid flick of the paw, launching a stinging cloud of fine dirt into the eyes. It causes blindness

name: Rock Throw
description: A strong, low toss of a small stone, which serves to both sting and distract enemies.

name: Mud Shot
description: A well-aimed spray of thick, viscous mud.

name: Sand Splash
description: The cat performs a wide, sweeping kick, showering all nearby foes with grit and debris.

name: Poisonous Claw
description: A sudden, calculating swipe, drawing a bead of toxic liquid onto the wound. Causes the enemy to be posioned

name: Leap-and-Hold
description: After leaping straight into the air, the cat lands hard on the opponent in a surprise attack.

name: Sneak Attack
description: A moment of stillness, then a silent, rapid dash from the edge of battle.

name: Ambush
description: The team strikes from multiple angles simultaneously in a coordinated, frenetic flurry.

name: Enraged Charge
description: A last-ditch, low-stamina head-butt.

name: Tail Attack
description: A fast, broad sweep of the tail, used to trip or knock an enemy off balance.

name: Strong Tail
description: A heavy, powerful tail whip delivered with a mighty crack.

name: Hyper Roar
description: The cat unleashes a deafening, vibrating roar that rattles an enemy's bones.

name: Sharp Claw
description: A focused, intense claw strike that slices deep and slightly boosts your Strength with each attack.

name: Poisonous Fang
description: A quick, deep bite, leaving behind a toxic residue.

name: Strong Push
description: The cat lunges forward, using its mass to shove the enemy away.

name: Bulk up
description: After taking a moment to tense its muscles and broaden its stance, the cat seems to increase in size. Increases Strength with each attack (up to 3 times).

name: Loud Hissing
description: A thunderous hiss that ripples across the battlefield, distracting foes.

name: Teeth Grip
description: A standard attack where the cat sinks its teeth into an enemy’s limb. This slightly reduces enemy Speed with each attack.

name: Lightning Strike
description: The cat attacks from one angle, then feigns a retreat, only to attack again from another angle. It slightly reduces enemy Resilience with each attack.

name: Poisonous Stab
description: A single, quick strike using a sharp claw or fang that sinks deep into an enemy.

name: Upright Lock
description: The cat locks onto its opponent, rending and tearing with teeth and claws. This reduces enemy Instinct slightly with each attack.

name: Berserk Rush
description: In a frenzy of motion, the cat charges an enemy with no regard for its own safety.

name: Wrestle
description: A powerful move that deals damage and may also Stress an opponent.

name: Body Slam
description: The cat leaps high and lands heavily on an opponent. This action slightly reduces enemy Agility with each attack.

name: Warning Growl
description: Reduces enemy Strength with each attack (up to 3 times).

name: Dirt Kick
description: The cat paws the ground and flings debris directly into an opponent's face.

name: Deceptive Strike
description: The cat executes a confusing flurry of feints and attacks. This maneuver slightly reduces enemy Instinct with each attack.

name: Unbalancing Strike
description: A precise strike to the opponent's inner leg or base of the tail that causes Stress.

name: Belly Rake
description: The cat darts low and aims for an enemy's exposed, soft underbelly. May inflict Poison.

name: Covered Lunge
description: The cat darts behind a large object, then lunges out to ambush an opponent. This maneuver slightly boosts Agility with each attack.

name: Last Stand
description: The cat delivers a desperate but powerful attack that slightly reduces the cat's HP.

name: Overwhelm
description: The cat delivers a flurry of blows intended to break an enemy's concentration. This maneuver slightly reduces enemy Strength with each attack.

name: Scatter Attack
description: The cat swipes at the opponent, forcing them to break cover and give ground.

name: Throat Snap
description: A swift, dangerous strike aimed at an enemy's throat. This move slightly reduces enemy Agility with each attack.

name: Stone Guard
description: The cat plants its paws, refusing to be moved by any attack. This boosts its Resilience with each attack (up to three times).

name: Hunker Down
description: The cat lowers into a defensive position, minimizing its profile. Reduces Stamina consumption for 2 turns. All moves cost 50% less Stamina for the duration (does not stack).

name: Play Dead
description: The cat feigns a weak defensive move to goad an enemy into attack. Enrages the enemy.

name: Hissing Parry
description: The cat deflects an opponent's blow, then follows up with a distracting hiss.

name: Poisonous Surprise
description: In a surprise move, the cat uses a poisonous berry to turn the tables on its opponent.

name: Dust Bomb
description: A small explosion of kicked-up dust that obscures the view of the battleground.

name: Pin Down
description: The cat uses its weight and momentum to crush an opponent. This maneuver slightly reduces enemy Strength with each attack.

name: Mega Splash
description: A powerful strike that hits an opponent like a tidal wave.

name: Tail Whip
description: The cat spins to unleash a stunning tail strike.

name: Hunting Leap
description: A graceful, high leap followed by a focused attack upon landing. Slightly boosts Agility with each attack.

name: Thick Fur
description: The cat puffs out its fur, appearing to grow larger and becoming more resilient. This maneuver boosts Resilience with each attack (up to three times).

name: Defensive Curl
description: The cat goes into a defensive curl to protect itself and brace for attack. Boosts Strength with each attack (up to 3 times).

name: Dust Cloud
description: A quick dispersal of dry dust into the air, clouding the enemy's vision.

name: Misdirection
description: The cat performs an intricate series of feints, leading the enemy to attack the emptiness in its wake.

name: Guerilla Attack
description: A swift, coordinated strike executed as the team weaves through the battlefield.

name: Elders' Guidance
description: The cat closes its eyes, taking a moment of quiet focus to draw upon all the strength and wisdom they learned from their elders. This boosts Strength and Instinct with each attack (up to three times).

name: Partner Fighting
description: The next time a teammate is attacked, you take half of the damage instead. Absorbs 50% of the damage a teammate would receive.

name: Payback
description: The cat inflicts the same amount of damage it received this round. User moves last. Deals damage equal to damage received this turn.

name: Go for the Ears
description: A swift, sharp swipe of the claws aimed at the enemy's sensitive ears. Slightly reduces enemy Instinct with each attack.

name: StarClan Charge
description: The cat glows faintly before charging forward, leaving a shimmer in its wake.

name: Ancestral Roar
description: A spectral roar echoes across the battlefield, freezing enemies in their tracks.

name: Go for the Tail
description: The cat darts around the enemy, aiming low with fast nips at their tail or hindquarters. This maneuver slightly reduces enemy Resilience with each attack.

name: Spirit Ward
description: A faint blue shield shimmers around the team, strengthening their resolve. Slightly boosts Resilience and Instinct for all allies with each attack.

name: Foresight
description: The cat's eyes flash white, channeling StarClan's blessing to boost the team's speed. This greatly boosts Agility for all allies with each attack.

name: Go for the Eyes
description: An extremely swift, precise strike aimed at an enemy's eyes and face.

name: Go for the Paws
description: A continuous flurry of low attacks binds the enemy's feet and impedes their movement. This greatly reduces enemy Speed with each attack.

name: Sand Storm
description: A vortex of sand and spirit-dust whips up, affecting all enemies. Slightly reduces enemy Instinct and Resilience each attack.

name: Substitute
description: The cat shrouds itself in a ghostly image, distracting the enemy. The next attack targeting a teammate is redirected the image, which takes no damage. Slightly boosts Agility for all allies with each attack.

name: Invisible Strike
description: The cat vanishes momentarily, then seems to appear from nowhere to strike.

name: Poisonous Smoke
description: A dense, choking cloud of noxious vapor spreads out to blanket enemies.

name: Killing Bite
description: A high-risk, desperate leap aimed to deliver a killing blow.

name: Final Showdown
description: A final, all-in grapple where both combatants refuse to yield.

name: Force of Will
description: The cat stands tall, emitting a wave of spiritual energy to revitalize the team. Fully recovers Stamina for all allies, but the team becomes Stressed for the next round.
